rate.source_name: Swiss Federal Office for Housing (BWO) — Steuern und andere Abgaben, published 2026-08-28
rate.note: BWO explicitly identifies Zürich among the cantons without a statutory Beherbergungsabgabe. The city council separately states that the local Kurtaxe/City Tax is not a public tax, and current Zürich Tourismus statutes identify hotel-agreement funding. The contractual City Tax is represented exactly once in accommodation_charges. No second statutory city charge has been verified.

periods.exemptions: Not applicable to the absent statutory accommodation visitor tax. VAT and contractual property charges are separate.

absence_evidence.finding: Current federal legal explanation explicitly says Zürich has not introduced a Beherbergungsabgabe; municipalities can tax only within cantonal authorisation.

absence_evidence.source_name: Zürich City Council — resolution 115 of 2014-02-26, answer to question 5, p. 3
absence_evidence.finding: Explains that the locally named Kurtaxe is not a public tax, but the hotels’ City Tax contribution to Zürich Tourismus.
Logiernachttaxen are funded under agreements with the hotel association and other hotel businesses.

calculation.supported_case: No statutory accommodation visitor-tax component in the named jurisdiction as checked; this does not resolve other hotel fees.
refuse_when: evidence no longer applies to the travel date or property jurisdiction
a new enacted rule supersedes this observation
calculation.result_rule: Emit no statutory-tax charge, with the absence evidence attached. Do not manufacture a numeric source rate or require currency conversion for an absent charge.

tourist_tax.relationship_to_accommodation_charges: No duplicate statutory layer: the positively sourced absent statutory tax and the one conditional contractual City Tax describe different classifications, not two payable charges.

accommodation_charges.name: Zürich Tourismus City Tax — contractual tourism contribution

rate.unit: per guest per night at a property within the applicable agreement
rate.source_name: City of Zürich — tourism funding announcement
rate.note: The authority reports the increase in May 2023; the first day is not independently established by that announcement and must not be treated as an exact legal commencement. Current organisation financing page corroborates the amount: https://www.zuerich.com/de/business/ueber-zuerich-tourismus/organisation/nachhaltigkeitsberichte/nachhaltigkeitsbericht-2024/finanzen. This is a contractual contribution, not a citywide statutory tax.

applicability.scope: Hotels bound by the Zürich Hotelier Verein / Zürich Tourismus agreement or an individual participating-hotel agreement; no geographic presence alone establishes liability.
applicability.membership_rule: Zürich Tourismus statutes article 3 identifies hotel contributions under agreements; article 5 links lodging membership to the hotel association or GastroZürich, subject to exceptions.
applicability.exclusions: Being in Zürich alone does not establish an agreement or guest charge. No complete live hotel register or platform-collection rule was verified. A selected property may establish applicability through its own terms; the verified EMA House case below is not a citywide exemption policy.

verified_property_cases.property_operator: EMA House AG — Hotel Suites and Serviced Apartments
verified_property_cases.match_rule: Only a reservation at an EMA House property governed by the cited EMA House terms; not all Zürich accommodation. Confirm the exact property and any contractual departure from the standard terms.

rate.unit: per liable guest per night, including VAT
rate.note: Operator explicitly identifies remittance to Zürich Tourismus. Same City Tax as the scheme-level entry, not an additional charge.

exempt_age_up_to_inclusive.note: The wording exempts children and young people up to twelve.

maximum_chargeable_nights.unit: nights in the qualifying long stay
maximum_chargeable_nights.note: Operator states the fee ceases from the following night of a long stay.

verified_property_cases.quote_inclusion: Resolve against the booking: the same terms also describe prices as including taxes. Do not add the charge if the booking already includes it.

calculation.supported_case: A selected EMA House booking governed by the recorded terms, with age, chargeable nights and quote inclusion resolved; other hotels require their own verified terms.
refuse_when: no verified property match or applicable terms
guest exemption or quote inclusion unresolved
any selected tariff or FX input unconfirmed/disputed/expired
evidence_gaps: An exhaustive property register and scheme-wide age/long-stay/VAT rules are not verified; do not extrapolate the EMA House case. Exact historical commencement day remains unverified, so historical pricing is unsupported.

classification_evidence.finding: The City Tax is not a public tax.

The hotel describes the City Tax as levied by the city. This conflicts with the legal classification given by the public authorities. Retained as a terminology conflict, not evidence of a separate additive charge; governmental legal explanation governs classification.

deduplication_rule.booking_rule: Match scheme, property, guest and nights. A scheme observation, a hotel tariff and a booking line for the same contribution are evidence of one liability, not three charges. Labels alone are insufficient to identify a different fee; require separate issuer, purpose and legal/contractual basis before adding another.

unresolved: Research only: this is not the production cost schema and the app must never read it. A validated transform must reject unconfirmed and disputed records, and retain all product, geography, date, eligibility and purchase-channel restrictions on confirmed records.

research-v3: transit envelopes carry validity_area. Airport transfers use journey_legs and named taxi_tariffs categories; overall journey time, estimated taxi ranges and attraction visit durations are deliberately absent. Each taxi category has base_fare, per_km, per_waiting_minute and airport_surcharge envelopes. An optional published_waiting_rate preserves an hourly source without deriving a per-minute figure.

Prices are observations checked on the collection date, not promises for a future trip. A current official page without an explicit effective date is identified as such. No currency conversion, averages, estimated amounts or arithmetic replacement for a missing product are used. Null does not mean zero.

day_pass records only an explicitly specified validity product; service-day and consecutive-hour products must not be treated as interchangeable. pass_72h is not calculated from shorter passes. Nonexistence requires positive evidence, not an unsuccessful search.

Eating-out figures are named menu observations, not representative city averages. A published per-person menu has not been doubled to manufacture a two-person total. The midrange category is not an official restaurant classification.

The five attractions are a research selection rather than a verified popularity ranking. Booking evidence is placed in entry_price.note because the agreed boolean has no envelope. Null booking status is unknown; no availability or queue-time claim is made.

An empty accommodation_charges array means no non-statutory charge was verified in this research, not that every property is fee-free. Conditional levies must be matched to an actual property; universal=false forbids automatic addition to every trip.

Airport scope follows destination codes found in repository configuration/catalogue, not an independently verified live origin-flight schedule. Named endpoint fares are not terminal-to-hotel prices. No comparison claim is made where cheaper conditional products or alternate services remain unverified.

The ZRH fare is disputed between the dated operator schedule and the tourism page; the model must not silently choose the lower price. All ZVV prices require rechecking for trips from the announced December 2026 change.

The City Tax is stored as a conditional accommodation charge with universal=false. Its exact commencement day and complete property/exemption mapping remain unverified; no citywide tax or universal application is asserted.
Taxi operator tariff retrieval, Zoo Zürich date-specific admission, the two-person restaurant total and several explicit booking rules remain unresolved.

research-v4 adds the closed tax basis registry and calculation metadata. Conditional means the recorded formula supports only its named case with all required inputs; it does not mean a guest total is ready. Unknown basis, unsupported assessment, missing inputs and unresolved evidence must cause explicit refusal, never an average, nearest-shape mapping or zero.

Final taxi cross-check: the tourism page gives a general most-taxis tariff, but named operator 7x7 publishes no meter schedule at https://www.7x7.ch/en/chauffeur-services/taxis/. Its airport-pickup page https://www.7x7.ch/en/chauffeur-services/airport-pickup/ quotes a meet-and-greet service fee, not a fare to a specified city endpoint. Neither was relabelled as a verified airport-rank meter tariff or fixed transfer. Checked 2026-11-02.

Tax follow-up resolves the earlier statutory uncertainty: BWO and city-council evidence support not_offered. Beherbergungsabgabe/Kurtaxe/City Tax terminology alone does not prove a statutory tax. The existing contractual charge remains once, with universal=false.

The new EMA House case verifies one operator’s guest tariff, VAT inclusion and exemptions; it does not turn that charge into a universal Zürich levy. Other property and platform agreements still require evidence. Avoid duplicate addition when the booking already includes the City Tax.
